description_en: Detach the binding relationship between IP addresses and the connection address pool associated with the cloud connector
description_zh: 解除IP地址与云连接器关联的连接地址池的绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc dissociate-ip-from-connection-pool --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-id cp-bp11234abctmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DissociateIpFromConnectionPool

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request.
Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。
从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without detaching the binding relationship between the IP addresses and the connection address pool associated with the cloud connector. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. After passing the checks, the binding relationship between the IP addresses and the connection address pool associated with the cloud connector is detached immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会解除IP地址与云连接器关联的连接地址池的绑定关系。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接解除IP地址与云连接器关联的连接地址池的绑定关系
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: Region ID of the cloud connector instance. Only cn-hangzhou is supported
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例所在的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
List of IP addresses to be detached.
Up to 500 IP addresses can be specified. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
要解除绑定的IP地址列表。
最多支持传入500个IP地址。多个IP地址使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: ips

parameters.help_en:
OSS path of the template file, which corresponds to the OssPath parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313331.html API.

The format is `<BucketName>/<uid>/<FileName>`.

Ips and IpsFilePath cannot be specified at the same time. If the number of IP addresses is small, use Ips. If the number of IP addresses is large, we recommend using IpsFilePath to record all IP addresses to be detached in a template file and detach them in bulk
parameters.help_zh:
模板文件OSS地址，即https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313331.html接口的返回参数**OssPath**。

格式为`<BucketName>/<uid>/<FileName>`。

Ips和IpsFilePath不能同时填写，如果IP数量较少，可直接选择Ips方式，如果IP数量较多，建议选择IpsFilePath方式，将需要解绑的IP地址记录在模板文件中，整体解绑
parameters.name: ips_file_path
